name: yoke
description: Governed adversarial development for AI agents with pluggable canonical-memory providers. Three runtime subagents (Generator, Validator, Orchestrator) spawned in parallel inside a binding human contract. Canonical-memory reads and writes dispatch through providers.yaml to a peer plugin (claude-bedrock is the reference implementation); pluggable canonical-memory providers ship via the documented working-memory contract. Manifesto: yoke.md.
